label: EMAIL TIP
headline: Show a glimpse of your work process
body: Let your audience see the effort and passion behind what you create.
caption:
Sharing a little peek behind the curtain can make your emails more relatable and build a stronger connection with your audience. Whether it's a photo of your workspace, a quick video of you making something, or just a few sentences about how you come up with ideas, these insights help your subscribers feel like they know you better.
